subject: Analytics
question: A company profit is shown. One x-unit represents 5 years since 1980 and one plotted y-unit represents 25 thousand dollars. Using the endpoints of the line segment, find profit y(t) in thousands of dollars, where t is years since 1980.
original_question:
For the following exercises, which shows the profit, y, in thousands of dollars, of a company in a given year, t, where t represents the number of years since 1980.

Find the linear function  y,  where y depends on t, the number of years since 1980.
